g.text: BankDash Active Loans Interaction & Animation Locators
Visual mapping of 4 key interactive zones across the loans overview, repayment modal & live calculator
Loan Metric Elevation & Currency Tickers
Personal, Corporate, Business, and Custom loan metrics with smooth counter roll
TRIGGER: Page load / Hovering loan KPI card
Interactive Table Row Hover Glide
Full-width table with column alignment, subtle row zebra glow, and loan duration indicators
TRIGGER: Cursor movement across loan rows
Repay Action Button Pulse & Modal Drawer
Active button glow, ripple press effect, and accessible modal confirmation
with instant real-time balance deduction & toast notification feedback
TRIGGER: Clicking the Repay button on any loan
Grand Total Aggregation Highlight
Bottom summary footer with distinct bold typography, active loan tally, and left-to-repay total
TRIGGER: Automatic aggregation on loan repayment
KEY INTERACTIONS SUMMARY:
KPIs: Loan Tickers
Table: Row Hover Glide
Repay: Modal & Toast
Summary: Auto Aggregation
All interactions use GPU hardware-accelerated transforms & zero-layout-shift (CLS = 0.00) with accessible aria controls.
